measurement_notes: No request was sent for this report. Every number comes from the archived evidence or local counting.
provider_* fields are provider-billed usage; sent_local_* and revised_local_* are tiktoken o200k_base counts.
revised_* fields count what the editors at source.revised_editor_rules would send for the same cases.
Arms were sent in fixed U, S, X, SX order inside each case, so later arms inherit the provider prefix cache. USD and cache-miss deltas are confounded by send position and are not editor effects.
Trajectory slots differ in step counts between arms; their token totals mix description effects with different model behaviour and are reported per arm, not as a saving.
Accuracy n is tiny (2-3 cases per category, 20-22 scored per arm); differences of one case are not evidence.
archived_official_scores used underscore_to_dot=False, unlike the pinned DeepSeek FC entry; rescored_official_scores rescore the same result files with underscore_to_dot=True.
